claim: A simulator or verifier can disagree with what the Next shows: SkoolKit's simulator shows the plain palette, and a verifier that checks its own idea of a column can miss an overlay one column off.

evidence.text: The game writes the ULA+ palette; on a Next and in JNext the walls are pink, the jungle lime, the fire orange; SkoolKit's simulator shows the plain palette.
evidence.quote: on a Next and in JNext the walls are pink, the jungle lime, the fire orange.

evidence.text: The copy pops a table of screen addresses and adds 1 before use, so work column 0 is screen column 3; the verifier checked its own idea of the column and only the JNext screen showed the overlay one column left.
evidence.quote: Part 1's copy pops a table of screen addresses and adds 1 before use, so work column 0 is screen column 3.
